_doc: Open roles (components/careers.php). Each role expands as a native <details> - it works with no JS - and 'Apply' opens a dialog built from the shared lead form, with the job title travelling along so the enquiry arrives labelled. When 'items' is empty the 'empty_text' note shows instead, keeping the speculative route open.
title: Work with us
sub: Small team, long hours in season, and nobody who does not care how it is made.
dialog_text: Tell us a little about yourself and we will come back to you within a week.
empty_text: No openings right now - but we always read speculative applications, and most of our team arrived that way.

items.title: Counter staff
items.summary: Running the press, serving customers and keeping the counter looking like somewhere people want to stop.
responsibilities: Pressing to order and keeping the mill clean between batches
Serving, taking payment and handling collection orders
Opening or closing the counter, including stock checks
requirements: Comfortable on your feet through a busy shift
Happy talking to strangers all day
Food hygiene certificate, or willing to take ours

items.title: Delivery driver
items.summary: Getting the morning's pressing to wholesale customers cold and on time.
responsibilities: Loading the chilled van and running the morning route
Handling crate returns and signed deliveries
Being the face of the business at every drop
requirements: Clean UK licence held for two years or more
Early starts - the first run leaves at 5am
Careful with a load that does not like being shaken

items.title: Grower liaison
items.summary: Keeping the relationships with our farms honest, and the cane arriving when it should.
responsibilities: Visiting partner farms through the season
Agreeing cut dates and volumes with growers
Checking quality at source rather than on arrival
requirements: Agricultural background, or a genuine willingness to learn one
Able to travel for several days at a time in season
Patient - this job is mostly listening
